thread.title: Becoming A Venture Capitalist Through Overstock - Overstock.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSTK)

author: George Atuan, CFA
title: Becoming A Venture Capitalist Through Overstock - Overstock.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSTK)
text:
In my initial article , I suggested that the value of the e-commerce business of Overstock ( OSTK ) could reach $34.00 per share, which would imply a market value of $4.20 per share for Medici. In this article, we will explore the 13 startups in which Medici is invested and come up with a valuation using a probabilistic approach, which is common in Venture Capital funds.
Source: The Simpsons
Medici Medici Ventures is a venture fund within OSTK that invests in blockchain startups. Currently, Medici is invested in 13 startups that as we will see further down in the article, propose some interesting solutions and may disrupt a couple of industries. This space is crowded with 246 companies of which 152 are funded and they have raised 4.2bn (Source: Venture Scanner), so being able to predict which startup will be the winner in each vertical is challenging. Predicting the winner between Betamax and VHS was a challenge, imagine choosing a winner among dozens of startups.
What Is Blockchain? The most well-known and first application of blockchain has been bitcoin. After that, the universe of cryptocurrencies has exploded and as of now there are 1,904 cryptocurrencies with a market cap of 290MM USD .
The benefit of blockchain is that rather than counting on a centralised body to verify registries, transactions and identities, blockchain offers a decentralized ledger that is verified by the community. The advantage of such technology is that cutting the middleman, cost, transparency and speed of the transactions could be enhanced.
For example, right now, if you would like to buy shares of Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), you have to go to your broker, set an order and wait for it to execute. Once executed, the broker would charge you the commission. That commission pays the broker for matching the buyer/seller transaction, custody of the shares, settlement among other things. Using blockchain, the transaction would be instantaneous and verified by users of the platform avoiding most of the costs of the broker. Blockchain could be used anytime there is an intermediary needed to validate the transaction, think of real estate agents, online transactions and the list goes on.
On the other side, blockchain brings some disadvantages as well. As any new technology, regulations are behind and it needs to eventually catch up. As you can conclude, blockchain is gaining attention because it offers the promise to transform industry operating models. Thus, funding in blockchain projects continues to grow.
The 13 Startups Medici has 13 startups in five areas of interest. Unless specified, all information in this chapter was obtained from Venture Scanner or OSTK fillings.
This startup is working on developing a trusted online identity; it is very well explained in this video . The company was founded in 2008 by Dan Kolkowitz and Kieran Sherlock. Mr. Sherlock has 23 years of experience, 11 of which he spent at McAfee as a Senior Principal Engineer/Systems Architect. The current CEO is Garret Gafke.
Mr. Gafke seems to have extensive experience leading or being a board member of companies that eventually get acquired such as Paymate, which was acquired by Flexigroup and Anchor Bay Technologies acquired by Silicon Image (more details about his experience could be found on his LinkedIn profile ).
By mid-2014, he raised his first round for 1.8MM for IdentityMind Global, then at the end of the same year, Medici and other investors (Benhamou Global Ventures, Cybernaut Venture Capital, FortRoss Ventures, Fortress Investment Group, GF Trust, Jack Carsten, Lakewood & Company, Westlake Venture Partners, Westlake Ventures) invested in the series B an amount of 8.5MM. And in February of this year, a Series C raised another 10MM in which Medici also participated among other investors (Benhamou Global Ventures, Eastern Link Capital, Hanna Ventures, Overstock.com , Zanadu Capital Partners).
This specific space is crowded with 141 companies, of which 75% has been funded. The total capital raised has been around 3bn. No wonder there are so many startups in this space; market research firm Frost & Sullivan estimates the global market could reach $6.45 billion by 2020 . The main competitors in the IoT, Identity and Content Management are Bitmark , mediachain , SatoshiPay , Filament , evernym and chronicled.
The mission of DeSoto is to build a blockchain-based record-keeping for developing countries. This joint venture is between Medici (50% interest), Patrick Byrne (17%) and Hernando de Soto (33%). As you can see in the previous link, De Soto is a very influential economist who seems to know what he is talking about.
Bitt was founded in 2013 and operates a digital asset exchange developing a blockchain-based payment and banking solution to digitize fiat currencies. In this specific space, there are 338 companies but just 30% are funded and have raised 1.7bn. In the first quarter of 2013, they raised 1.5MM as seed money. In 2014, Medici was the only investor entering Series A with 4MM and in 2018 it was again the only investor in the Series B with 3MM.
Bitsy is a startup working on linking the U.S. Dollar and cryptocurrency markets. The main players in the exchanges and cryptocurrency trading space are coinbase , BTCChina , Korbit , Bitkan , Quoine , kraken , Bitstamp , Bitso , Paymium , coinsecure , bitaccess , luno , bitFlyer , ShapeShift , UnoCoin and OKCoin .
Ripio is a financial payment company using blockchain to offer electronic payment solutions for businesses in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, and Ecuador that needs to settle international transactions or bitcoins. The founders are Mugur Marculescu, Luciana Gruszeczka and Sebastian Serrano. The space is crowded with 105 companies of which only 41 have been funded and raised a total of 723mm.
The company has been successful raising capital (44.5m) mostly (37mm in an ICO in 2017). Medici invested in mid-2017 in the series A. Currently, it has 100K+ active users in Latin America . Among the wallets and money services startups in this space are coins.ph , uphold , Netki , coinplug , wyre , snapcard , streami , xapo , abra , circle , Ledger , coinjar .
PeerNova assists financial institutions to secure and manage their data using blockchain, cloud and big data. PeerNova has raised $30M in financing to date, with participation from Mosaik Partners, Medici, Steve Case, Dr. Azhar Aziz (Founder/CTO of FireEye) and other prominent investors.
Spera is a back-office task management tool that helps freelancers get paid by automatically initiating an invoice, facilitating payments, and keeping track of jobs. The company was founded in 2014 and apparently just raised 2MM in series A from Medici in mid-2017.
Symbiont has developed a platform for smart contracts for digital securities and ownership records. In May 2017, Symbiont raised 15MM through a series A round and that is when Medici invested. There are four founders Adam Krellenstein, Mark Smith, Evan Wagner and Robby Dermody. Blockchain startups addressing the capital markets and financial services includes ripple , LedgerX , Chain , Hijro , Blockstream , Digital Asset Holding , Axoni , SolidX , Paxos , SETL , Cryex , NeuFund and funderbeam .
Factom uses blockchain to secure real-time records. In April 2017, Factom raised 8MM though its series A round implying a valuation of 40-80MM. The competition in the enterprise services and currencies include blocko , BigchainDB , Hashed , colu , Blockcypher and orbs .
Medici owns 80% of tZero and is Medici's largest investment so far. Currently, when you purchase a security on traditional exchanges, the trade is settled in three days "t+3," while for the investor it is transparent, there is lots of costs behind the scenes. What tZero is proposing is an immediate settlement using blockchain. As tZero would avoid most of the costs of traditional exchanges, the commission would be insignificant compared to the costs of traditional exchanges.
The global stock market traded 77 trillion USD in 2017 . We assumed a higher margin for tZero than NDAQ (30s%), OTCPK:EUXTF (60s%) and CBOE (30s%) as the whole premise of using blockchain and immediate settlement is that it would save a lot of the costs. As the EBITDA is of higher quality and its growth potential is higher than the competition, I think it should be trading at a higher multiple, however, I assumed it would trade in the same range.
Source: Author estimates
Source: Ycharts
Voatz is a platform that allows voting remotely and securely on smartphones and tables. In January of this year, it raised 2.2MM in its series A.
SettleMint is a secure voting system that also can be audited and has a document authentication method. Currently, it is in the process of ICO. SettleMint was founded by Matthew Van Niekerk and Roderik van der Veer.
The timing of these two ventures looks very opportune with all the issues with voter fraud. According to Heritage.org , there has been 1,132 proven instances of voter fraud . This issue is not just in the USA, but also in other parts of the world such as Venezuela .
There are other seven startups trying to solve the election problem, most of them using blockchain. Those are Sovereign (which has raised just 220k USD so far), Boule , followmyvote.com , Votem , Scytl (which has raised 129MM USD by Series D), ClearBallot (which has raised 18MM USD), and votebox .
Finclusive Capital is a new startup that was added during 1Q18. This startup helps to implement stronger risk and compliance controls in the traditional core banking using blockchain. As I do not have lots of information regarding this new startup, I did not include it in the analysis.
Valuing Medici As Medici owns less than 20% of most of these startups (save for tZero and DeSoto), it uses the Cost Method Investment and does not report the specific amount it invested nor how much it owns of each startup. I assumed that in each round, 10-25% of the company is sold and that there is an option pool. I should reiterate that this is a very speculative valuation as it has many assumptions embedded.
The table below estimates a range of the valuation of OSTK's stake in each startup. My estimates are based on the last round raised, the amount raised, in how many rounds Medici participated. As it is apparent, the success of tZero is the most relevant and it is no wonder the CEO focuses on tZero way more than the others on the calls.
Source: Author estimates
In general, 60% of the startups fail miserably, 30% breaks even or has a slight profit and 10% have a significant successful exit and usually pays for the loses. For Medici, I assumed that there is a 54% that all the ventures fail with a couple of mediocre exits and a 46% of a successful venture with normal exits. Further, I split the bad scenario in two and the good scenario in four and each with its probabilities.
Source: Author estimates
The scenarios seem all over the place for Medici from $1.70 to $313 per share. But if we take the probabilistic approach of a venture capital, the expected fair price of Medici would be $48/sh., that is somewhere between the "Good" and "Better" scenarios detailed above. Adding the e-commerce to Medici results in a fair price of $82 for the stock.
A note regarding my downside scenario for OSTK. In the worst-case scenario in which Medici is worth nothing and that the e-commerce business is not sold. I assume that the value should return to pre-Medici noise or to what BBBY would pay for it, which is around $19.00.
Keeping in mind the upside ($82/sh) and downside ($19/sh.), I would recommend building a position under $35, as it would offer a risk:reward profile (1:3) more in line with such type of risky investments.
Catalysts Among the many catalysts, the three most relevant ones are:
The divestment of the e-commerce business for a price above $23 per share. The implied value of Medici in the $82 expected price is of $48. In the worst-case scenario Medici could be worth nada. Those if the e-commerce business is monetized above $23 per share, the Medici "option" would be worth it.
Source: Author estimates
Enhancement of the economics and the strategy of the e-commerce unit. If Patrick finds a way to use blockchain technology to enhance the e-commerce operation, it has a double benefit. First, it would increase the value of the e-commerce unit and secondly it would work as a proof-of-concept of the related startup.
Monetization or success of tZero and/or a couple of the other startups. By far, tZero is the main catalyst but there are another 11 companies that are a wildcard.
Risks Along the same lines as the catalysts, one more risk I see is if they are not able to get financing. As previously mentioned, the CEO had to recur to his own family to obtain funds to pay a debt obligation… a very bad sign.
Conclusions Valuing OSTK is a challenging task as it combines an e-commerce business and a "venture capital fund." While OSTK seemed to be improving its margins in 1Q18 of the e-commerce business, I strongly believe that the only way to extract value from the business is by selling it to a third party that has bigger financial backs and a moat, both of which OSTK lacks. Among the four potential acquirers, I am betting on KSS as it seems to be better positioned for such an acquisition.
As for Medici Ventures, the best way to value it is by treating it as a regular venture capital fund and valuing a probabilistic value of the 13 startups. As I detailed above, all the startups sound promising and appear to have an attractive solution. However, as we all know, predicting the winning technology is a very tough task even for the experts such as Google.
Taking all that into consideration, under $35/sh, the stock offers a very attractive risk:reward profile. As this is a very speculative investment, I would recommend that you do not allocate more than 3% of your portfolio on this idea.
